description.value: The Gift Shop at River Rock Resort is a retail shop located within the River Rock Casino Resort complex in Richmond, BC. As part of a large casino resort property, it is accessible to the general public and may carry convenience items alongside souvenirs and resort merchandise. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond on routes near the Fraser River could use this as a potential stop within the resort.
